snap.lede: A snapshot saves the whole computer as it is now. Restore it later, or start a new computer from it.
snap.full: This computer holds the most snapshots it can ({{max}}). Delete one from its ⋯ menu to take a new one.
snap.error: The snapshots could not be read.
take.title: Take a snapshot
take.taken: A snapshot named {{name}} already exists, so nothing was taken. Choose another name.
take.unread: The snapshots could not be read just before sending, so nothing was taken. Try again.
take.state: Only a running or stopped computer can take a snapshot.
field.snapRule: 2 to 64 letters, digits, - or _, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
from.title: New computer from {{snap}}
from.lede: A new computer starts from the snapshot {{snap}} of {{name}}. It shows as copying in the list until it is ready.
from.projectOutside: This computer's project is not in this realm. Pick a project here for the new computer.
from.noProject: This realm has no project yet, so a computer cannot be made here. Make a project in this realm first.
from.realmRefused: This realm did not allow it. The answer does not say which rule: the project, the source computer or the server picked may not be in this realm, or this login may not be allowed to do this here. Check the project, the computer's realms and the server, then try again.
field.name: Name
held.take: A snapshot named {{name}} may already have been taken. Check the list before trying again.
held.copyFrom: A computer named {{name}} may already have been made from a snapshot. Check the list before trying again.
held.dismissBody: Stop tracking only if you know it did not go through. If it did, sending again makes a second one.
held.dismissBodyChange: Only stop tracking if you know it did not go through. If it did, sending it again repeats the change.
err.COMPUTER_SNAPSHOT_LIMIT: This computer already holds its maximum number of snapshots.
err.SNAPSHOT_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another snapshot change is running on this computer. Try again in a moment.
err.SNAPSHOT_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE: The server could not list this computer's snapshots, so none was taken. Try again later.
err.COMPUTER_NAME_IN_USE: That name is already used by another computer.
badge.label: {{count}} snapshots of {{name}}: open them
drop.title: Delete {{name}}?
drop.body: The snapshot {{name}} is deleted for good. You cannot start a computer from it afterwards.
held.drop: The snapshot {{name}} may already have been deleted. Check the list before trying again.
zip.title: Download folders
zip.lede: Each folder comes as one .zip, straight from {{name}} to your browser, which shows the progress.
zip.notRunning: Start the computer to download its files.
zip.noAddress: This computer's files program has no address yet.
zip.full: At most {{max}} folders in the list. Remove one to add another.
zip.started: Started {{when}}. Your browser shows the progress.
zip.over: Over 100,000 files: may be too big. Try it, or its subfolders.
zip.under: Under 100,000 files: should fit in one .zip.
pick.title: Folders of this computer
pick.error: The folders could not be read.
pick.top: The top cannot be added: open a folder and add that.
take.expiryHelp: Optional, 1 to 3650. Empty uses the server's default.
restore.title: Restore {{name}}?
restore.body: {{computer}} goes back to how it was when {{name}} was taken. Files and settings changed since then are lost. Take a new snapshot first if you may want them.
held.restore: Restoring {{name}} may already have gone through. Check again before trying a second time.
rename.title: Rename {{name}}
rename.lede: The label shown in the list. The snapshot's own name stays {{name}}. Leave it empty to remove the label.
field.label: Label
field.labelRule: Up to 100 characters, with no hidden or control characters.
held.rename: The label of {{name}} may already have changed. Check again before trying a second time.
err.COMPUTER_NETWORK_POLICY_MISSING: This computer has no network settings in force yet, so it cannot be restored. Set up its network first.
err.COMPUTER_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Another change is running on this computer. Try again in a moment.
err.COMPUTER_QUARANTINED: This computer is held for review, so it cannot be changed now.
drop.changed: {{name}} has changed since you opened this question (it was replaced), so nothing was deleted. Check it, then delete again.
drop.unread: The snapshots could not be read just before sending, so nothing was deleted. Try again.
drop.gone: {{name}} was already deleted, so there is nothing more to do. The list is up to date.
restore.missing: {{name}} is no longer in the list, so nothing was restored. The list is up to date.
restore.changed: {{name}} has changed since you opened this question (it was replaced), so nothing was restored. Check it, then restore again.
restore.unread: The snapshots could not be read just before sending, so nothing was restored. Try again.
row.busy: Wait until the change shown above settles.
take.heldReason: Check the snapshot that may already have been taken first.
take.fullReason: This computer holds the most snapshots it can. Delete one first.
glance.title: At a glance
col.name: Snapshot
kind.memory.tip: It also holds what was running (memory), so a restore picks up where it left off.
zip.drawer.title: Add a folder
snap.emptyBody: Take one before a big change, so you can go back to it.
snap.partialOld: The list shown was already missing snapshots it could not read.
